AgentChatService: candidate orchestration
|-- genAlternatives(): parent chat caller -> persisted child records
|   |-- Require workspace access, tools, source canvas and a prior user message
|   |-- Validate 1-8 unique names and prompts; forbid nested generation
|   |-- generationRequests owns signature, runId and candidate view/chat IDs
|   |   `-- Same requestId replays receipt; changed arguments conflict
|   |-- Live parent identity/version -> canvas-generation start
|   |   `-- CanvasHistory.startGeneration() exports saved finalCheckpointId
|   |-- Save children and request receipt before parent start command
|   `-- Save returned history on each child; schedule starts together
|-- launchGeneration(): each candidate owns one thread and managed turn
|   |-- Snapshot inherited tools; carry model, effort, cwd and access settings
|   |-- thread/fork uses beforeTurnId for an active parent turn
|   |   `-- Otherwise use lastTurnId when present; defer goal continuation
|   |-- Saved AgentContext instead uses thread/start + thread/inject_items
|   |   `-- Carry saved context ID/hash; injected snapshot is reference data
|   |-- Persist child thread; thread/goal/clear prevents inherited continuation
|   |-- Check cancellation before creating controller and starting turn
|   `-- GenerationCanvasBridge.add() -> isolated binding -> startTurn()
|       `-- Callback stores exported history in that child's generation record
`-- Progress and cancellation: AgentChatService owns terminal settlement
    |-- CanvasGeneration: queued -> generating -> finished/failed/cancelled
    |-- Usage subtracts fork baseline; waitingForInput reflects pending requests
    |-- cancelGeneration(): mark cancelled before interrupt()
    |   |-- interrupt() waits for pending start, then interrupts active turn
    |   `-- Mark chat interrupted; finishGeneration() settles result
    |-- Parent interrupt() cancels all its running generation children
    |-- Cancel during thread launch: unsubscribe newly created thread
    |-- Launch errors / turn completion enter finishGeneration()
    |   `-- settlingGenerations coalesces concurrent settlement
    `-- Server restart marks running generations failed; chats remain reviewable
